title: Japan Inflation Rises Above BOJ Target Level, Backing Rate Hikes
summary: Japan’s key price gauge rose above the Bank of Japan’s target level for the first time this year, supporting the case for a widely expected BOJ interest rate hike in December.

title: Australia’s Victoria State Approves $700 Million Gas Project
summary: Australia’s Victoria state has approved the production license for a A$1 billion ($700 million) natural gas project to help avoid a forecast gas shortage.
